logical_entity_types.description: A main business thing with its own identity, such as Customer or Product.
A business document or exchange, such as SalesOrder or Invoice. Its lines are transaction_line.
One line of a transaction, such as SalesOrderLine or InvoiceLine.
A short list of codes and their meanings, such as Country or OrderStatus.
Links entities many-to-many, such as ProductCategory.
Something that happened at a point in time, such as a login or a shipment scan.
None of the listed types fits; the entity definition says what it is.

output_schema.title: _CompactLogicalCandidate
output_schema.description: Return only new or changed Logical records in the three arrays; omitted saved records stay as they are. Cite tables by table_index id (t1) and columns as t1.column. For a saved Entity or Attribute, send its identity plus only the fields you change. The backend adds each new Entity's <Entity>ID key, audit columns, column and dependency order, locks and the parent key of each Relationship, and copies a missing Attribute definition from its single source column's Project description. Relationships point from the child's foreign-key Attribute to the parent Entity. Retire saved records in retire; nothing is deleted. Coverage target is 70% of distinct selected Objects, rounded up, through active Entity sources, including unchanged saved records. On repair, fix every context.repair.validation_issues entry and return the complete corrected answer, not a patch.
